articles.summary: TORONTO, Ontario – November 19, 2026 – Blue Moon Metals Inc. (“​Blue Moon​” or the “​Company​”) (TSXV: MOON; NASDAQ: BMM) is pleased to announce a major permitting milestone at its 100%-owned Blue Moon zinc-gold-silver-copper mine (the “Blue Moon Mine” or the “Project”) in Mariposa County, California. The U.S. Bureau of Land Management (“BLM”) has approved the Project’s Plan of Operations […]
